# HELIX Documentation

> Official documentation for the **HELIX** platform by Hypersonic Laboratories: a modkit and game where creators build, script, and publish multiplayer 3D worlds. This site covers HELIX Studio (the Unreal Engine 5 based editor), Lua and JavaScript scripting, the HELIX Character Creator, custom assets, Blueprints, and the gameplay API.

Conventions for using these docs:

- Pages are written for creators and scripters. Tutorials are task-oriented; the API and QBCore sections are reference material.
- Scripting has two surfaces: **Lua** (the primary scripting API, under "API" and "Scripting") and **HelixJS** (a JavaScript/TypeScript layer).
- Canonical class names are capitalized (for example `HCharacter`, `HPlayer`, `HVehicle`).
- This file lives at `https://docs.helixgame.com/llms.txt`. Each link points to the rendered page; append nothing to fetch it.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.helixgame.com/getting_started/): What HELIX is and how the platform fits together.
- [Install HELIX](https://docs.helixgame.com/getting_started/install/): Install HELIX Studio and the game client.
- [Basic controls](https://docs.helixgame.com/getting_started/basic_controls/): Default in-game and editor controls.
- [Create your first HELIX world](https://docs.helixgame.com/tutorials/create_helix_world/): End-to-end walkthrough of building and launching a world.
- [Coming from GTA/FiveM](https://docs.helixgame.com/getting_started/comingGTA/): Orientation for creators moving from GTA/FiveM.

## Concepts

- [LIX](https://docs.helixgame.com/about/lix/): The platform currency and how it is used.
- [Instant hosting](https://docs.helixgame.com/about/hosting/): How HELIX hosts and runs published worlds.
- [Vault](https://docs.helixgame.com/about/vault/): The asset and package distribution system.
- [Collectibles & market](https://docs.helixgame.com/about/collectibles_market/): Collectibles and the in-platform market.
- [IP ownership](https://docs.helixgame.com/about/ip_ownership/): Who owns content created on HELIX.
